cases.purpose: Exercise the unchanged release passwd set-fd required-kernel-secret path against the experimental real secret-slot module.
cases.oracle: Actual Linux ioctl results from the hash-bound stage-1 module, its independent C real-device control, private synthetic data, and Debian libargon2 with a known vector. The storage backend is newly authored from reviewed callers; original kernel source and production policy have not been recovered. Separate KUnit execution is required for internal erasure evidence.
cases.comparison: All seccomp-notified calls continue to the real kernel. Require real authority opens and secret-slot ioctls, exact statuses and private-account results. The auth case drives three bounded PTY prompts, checks disabled echo and restoration, sealed comparisons, explicit clear and absent old handles on a fresh fd. Password hashes are checked with independent libargon2 in the project hex transport format; standard-PHC coverage is unchanged.
cases.stdout: passwd-stage1 set real-device=yes statuses=yes private-accounts=yes independent-kdf=yes
cases.adjudication: Original setup lacked the explicitly required reference artifacts. This separately named case preserves every script, helper hash, root/namespace/kernel/capability check and assertion; transport exact pinned module, independent device control and libargon2 via --references. Retain prior setup ERROR and any new FAIL/ERROR. Native erasure and UID2000 consumer obligations remain separate.
